notes.title: Update 5 [08 Sep 2025]
notes.content:
[p][/p][h1]Retro filters[/h1][p]Little backstory. [/p][p]Initially, Blessed Burden started as a heavily stylized retro PSX-like game. In the course of development, we came to the conclusion that the pixelated look did not provide enough value to the player, so we put that idea on the bookshelf to focus on what truly matters: levels, gameplay, gamefeel, story, and beautiful brutalistic architecture. [/p][p]And now, after game release and 4 updates, we decided to spend some time and pay homage to the initial game vision. These filters are optional and disabled by default.[/p][p]There are 3 levels of pixellation effect:[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/f6163c7f60b5b4c8b6c8044c52eb7397a4fdf7f0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/1d1a486a7a71823add8beab66176a02829d313af.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/ee1e53a3567e51fe7885448081674e112792d3c4.png"][/img][/carousel][p]And 2 levels of color precision effect:[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/541b716160b4ad495d76093cba67d70695753cd1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/1dd399a8b93b3a28810a5e146952317ea752c0fb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/f6163c7f60b5b4c8b6c8044c52eb7397a4fdf7f0.png"][/img][/carousel][p]You can mix and match these effects, so you can find the best fit for your taste.
Retro effects are located at the bottom of the general settings tab.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/ff6b7fff5526d8fa8c2875b22fd79ce093245c72.png"][/img][/p][h1]Rush timer[/h1][p]A feature for gamers who like speed and competition. A built-in timer that shows real time spent in the game and time spent actually running on levels.
Rush timer is located under the additional settings tab.
When feature is enabled, just enter the first stage (Gateway) and timer will start and show up in the top-left corner. It stops when you complete the last (Heart) stage. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/6fcf7ce4d61d70e0d1bf2d856d5229750e85628b.png"][/img][/p][h1]Small QoL setting[/h1][p]There is now a setting to control the damage effect strength. Damage effect feature was expanded in the recent update and now includes not only fall damage but also damage from deadly traps. [/p][p]Damage effect is purely visual feedback of the situation when the player was on the edge of death. If this effect bothers you, then you can make it subtle or disable it completely. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/c2ae0e80df60845f40ca43036cec3a8b483876b3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing! [/p][p]Don't forget to leave a review on Steam, it really makes a difference.[/p][p]Have a good one <3[/p]

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
[h1]Localization updates[/h1][p]Added new localizations:[/p][list][*][p]Chinese (Simplified)[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish (Spain)[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish (Latin America)[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese (Portugal)[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese (Brazil)[/p][/*][*][p]Polish
[/p][/*][/list][h1]Difficulty levels[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/90dd4c4dab9e348808b4d31db4ab37465015c7f3.png"][/img][/p][p]Now you can choose one of four difficulties at the beginning of the game (create a new save slot).[/p][olist][*][p][b]The Pilgrim's Way[/b] => A gentle journey. Unlimited deaths and respawns — continue until you succeed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sacred Trial[/b] => Three lives per stage. On your third death, the stage restarts from the beginning.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ghostrun[/b] => One life per stage. A single death restarts the stage from the beginning.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maledictus[/b] => One life for the entire game. If you die, all saves are erased and you start from the very beginning.
[/p][/*][/olist][h1]Medals[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/7173d6d140d7ae93673e1869838c9f33fe749e63.png"][/img][/p][p]Now you can get a medal for each level. Medals have 5 ranks. The shorter your time to complete the stage, the cooler the medal. The timings for each stage are different.
[/p][h1]Achievements[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/0579cad19bc8f02da17613440a11852f573c98bc.png"][/img][/p][p]4 new achievements associated with medals. [/p][h1]
General[/h1][list][*][p]"Race ghost" is a default feature now. You can turn it off in Settings -> Additional.[/p][/*][*][p]You can turn off tutorials in Settings -> Additional.[/p][/*][*][p]Bunny hop was improved.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Thank you for playing! We are happy to make these updates for you![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 3 [09 Jul 2025]
notes.content:
[h1]General updates[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/5a6f206e790c348e8bf5c0f97c27d6671507c1aa.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Japanese localization beta (more languages are on the way)[/p][/*][*][p]Epic game title in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Input support[/p][/*][*][p]Official Linux and Steam Deck support![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Race Ghost[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/2842b77387b53217f36c444bd80754c3457c176b.png"][/img][/p][p]Now you can race against your previous best run. 
To enable this feature, go to Settings>Additional>Race Ghost. 
You will need to run level once to be able to see the ghost. [/p][p]Honestly, I didn't expect this to be that much fun! Go check it out in the game![/p][p]In the future, I would love to attach ghosts to leaderboard entries, allowing you to race against other players too![/p][p][/p][h1]For speedrunners[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Finally, a fix for the dash-slide spam issue is publicly available. 
Unfortunately, this means some leaderboard entries will be removed, as some of the runs are impossible now.
Fix introduces the "stamina" mechanic to the game, which should remove the burden of clicking buttons as fast as humanly possible, and instead motivates players to seek the best routes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added input buffer time for dash and jump actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Landing no longer consumes a physics tick.[/p][/*][*][p]Key pickup radius doubles when moving faster than 20m/s.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an experimental option to increase tick rate for more precise movement calculations. This is a performance-heavy setting and should be used only when game is running on more than 200 frames per second. For now, this setting does not persist between sessions and should be manually enabled every time you launch the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/be5404a7f6a24b460cfd739a9f45449d3ae980a0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Misc[/h1][p][/p][p]I'm very proud of myself for adding localizable and device-adaptable input icons to the game. [/p][p]A small, hard-to-notice QoL improvement for yall.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/26fdc6f1e8b2cf799812408a2358a016769039f6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/27d45dc22fca86a126a646e5e7e0e98839d1d264.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/635dee8b93dd27bdead29541386e11e02d3fd488.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Cheers! Thanks for playing! [/p][p]It means a lot to our team <3[/p]

notes.title: Small patch with fixes
notes.content: [p]Nothing huge, just fixing my mistakes with visible triggers and invisible walls on some stages.[/p][p]Also, small adjustments on the Towers stage.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2 [28 Jun 2025]
notes.content:
[p]Gamepad support, save slots, Steam Cloud saves, lighting improvements, new settings, and some fixes. Sneak peek into the roadmap.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gamepad Support[/h2][p]You can now play the [b]entire game using a gamepad[/b] — from menus to intense platforming.[/p][p]If anything feels off or you'd like to suggest tweaks, let us know![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/8e2e06ee91c7ea01d422a829868369555f7d2448.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Save Slots + Steam Cloud[/h2][list][*][p][b]Multiple save slots[/b] added. You no longer have to sacrifice collected relics to start a new run — try New Game challenges freely.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Cloud[/b] support is now live — your progress travels with you.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/337a0c8c60be8a2c3ed492281967550ae2c4a758.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Lighting improvements[/h2][p]Lighting has been improved and fixed across all stages.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/ca32508ef5115dc25df4ffdd76d9efba799fcb9b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/c73f55f35e1b384d706cc5466dd0cd59ef6b3ef0.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2]New settings[/h2][p]Two new toggles have been added under [i]Additional Settings[/i]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Show Center Dot[/b] – Helps with aiming precise dashes or spatial orientation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hide Wings[/b] – Some players found them distracting, so now you can disable them entirely.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fixes and Tweaks[/h2][p]Here are the most noticeable improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed player's leg clipping into the camera during dash.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heart[/b] stage layout updated: sections 2 and 3 have been swapped for better pacing. [strike]skip?[/strike][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed finish line triggers on multiple stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed snakes' visuals and lighting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Roadmap Sneak Peek[/h2][p]We're working hard to take Blessed Burden even further. Here's what’s on the horizon, in rough order of priority:[/p][olist][*][p]Fix slide spam abuse - the highest priority task that changes core game mechanics. There is currently a discussion in our Discord server about that: [url="https://discord.gg/t5s68qpD5J"]https://discord.gg/t5s68qpD5J[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]New localizations. Japanese and Chinese (Simplified) are the first to come.[/p][/*][*][p]Add new game modes/difficulties:[/p][list][*][p]Casual (the current game mode)[/p][/*][*][p]Challenging (fewer checkpoints, 3 deaths lead to a restart of the stage)[/p][/*][*][p]Ghostrun (any death leads to a stage restart)[/p][/*][*][p]Helldive (any death resets a game and starts from the beginning)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Official Steam Deck support[/p][/*][*][p]Add an in-game ranking for completing the stage based on time. Like bronze, silver, gold medals, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Ghost replays – race your own or others' past runs.[/p][/*][*][p]Add legit skips to some annoying stages, like Facility.[/p][/*][*][p]Add new secrets on the levels that are optional and do not affect upgrades. Some of them will be possible to find only with full upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Add some customization options. Currently, pants and shoes are being discussed. Would love to hear your ideas on that![/p][/*][*][p]Halloween special event![/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]A Personal Note[/h2][p]We love working on this game, and there’s so much more we want to build. But we’re a small team, and to keep going we need your help.[/p][p]If you enjoy Blessed Burden, please consider:[/p][list][*][p]Leaving a review[/p][/*][*][p]Inviting friends[/p][/*][*][p]Posting a clip or TikTok[/p][/*][*][p]Recommending game to your favorite content creators or streamers[/p][/*][/list][p]Every bit of support helps us keep creating. Thank you for playing![/p]

notes.title: Update 1 [23 Jun 2025]
notes.content: [h1]Overview[/h1][p]This update brings a range of improvements to core gameplay systems, visuals, and level design. Below is a breakdown of what's been changed or added.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/49236aa3249d9d1d9d260f671523fc2d1d1117da.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/1eceeb002e0fb6420cb481b5acc351dcdc5998a4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/a4b92a0867992b138c788210b576b7c63bd7843e.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h1]Gameplay Fixes and Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Traps are no longer random and now behave consistently after each restart.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed destructible columns — they should no longer break on the first touch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fall damage calculation has been corrected for more predictable results.[/p][/*][*][p]Hitboxes improved so that deaths from traps feel more fair.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Movement[/h1][p]We’ve expanded the movement system to be more flexible and responsive:[/p][list][*][p]Priest can now dash while crouching in mid-air.[/p][/*][*][p]Priest can now jump while sliding.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Controls and Settings[/h1][list][*][p]Added a new [b]Field of View[/b] setting. For technical reasons it's capped at 110 degrees.[/p][/*][*][p]It's now possible to assign an alternative key binding for each action.[/p][/*][*][p]A dedicated dash button has been added for gamepads \[R1-right shoulder].[/p][p](Game partially supports gamepad inputs. Mouse is required only to navigate menus.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Visual Enhancements[/h1][list][*][p]Added a blob shadow under the priest for better grounding.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual effects for slide, gravity, and dash abilities have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Blessings Bar finally has new visuals[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/305963cdf44201e716d1ebf5fd3463cac5866ae8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Level Design[/h1][p]Level design updates have been made across nearly all levels to improve flow, clarity, and challenge balance. Descent got the biggest changes, so go check it out if you're into speedrunning.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447060/b3f19b3c5db0cb3146ec0b6d4564348af37d05cf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Achievements and Leaderboards[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed the [b]Maximum power[/b] achievement for collecting all relics.[/p][p](To retrigger the achievement simply complete any stage.)[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a temporary leaderboard viewer from the Stage Select menu.[/p][p](It's clunky for now, but you no longer need to finish the level to see your position on the leaderboard.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing, and as always, your feedback is welcome![/p]
